text: Harper Alley and Harper Audio present Pete the Cat and the Space Chase by Kimberly and James Dean performed by James Foley Meet Pete the Cat also known as Secret Agent Meow. His beeper is going off with an urgent message. We need you Agent Meow. Agent Meow answers his beeper. Meow here what's the trouble? Reports of flashing lights and loud noises at the playground. Noises on the playground? At night? I'm on it. Pete pulled a pair of spy binoculars out of his spy stuff cabinet. At the playground, Agent Meow spots something out of this world. Wow! A spaceship! The spaceship landed in the middle of the playground. Ping, ping, ping, peep, peep, peep. Agent Meow scans the ship for alien life. Looks empty. Time to check things out. With a click, the spaceship opened. Agent Meow jumped into the spaceship and pushed buttons. This calls for bravery. This calls for stealth. This calls for launching ship in three, two, one. A seatbelt. Yow! And the spaceship launched as Agent Meow pulled on his seatbelt. Ping, ping, ping, something was on his radar screen. What's this? It's another spaceship hot on my tail. You're not catching me. See you later, alligator. Agent Meow zips past Mars. He zooms past Jupiter. Agent Meow dodges flying rocks and soars past Saturn, but he cannot get away from the spaceship. Then with a p-p-p-punk, Agent Meow has a problem. Oh no! Out of gas? All of a sudden, a bright light pulls Agent Meow's ship in. Hey, stop that! Agent Meow's ship docks. The door begins to open. He is surrounded by little space cats. Whoa! One jumps up to the ship. Agent Meow, welcome. Huh? I am Bloop of the planet Quackadoodle. Everyone is so excited to meet you. Meet me? How? We sent Agent Blorp to invite you to a party. And here you are with Blorp's ship. But where is Blorp? Oh my! I may have left Agent Blorp on Earth. That means we all get to go to Earth! The Quackadoodles cheer. One spaceship ride later. The large spaceship lands at the playground and Agent Meow and the Quackadoodles look around. There is no sign of Blorp anywhere. Have no fear. Agent Meow is on the case. Agent Meow takes out his magnifying glass and finds footprints. Look! Blorp made friends. Blorp is at a table with Agent Meow's friends. They have made him a cake saying, welcome to Earth. Agent Meow and the Quackadoodles join in the fun. The more the merrier. This is James Foley. This unabridged production of Pete the Cat and the Space Chase by Kimberly and James Dean. Presented by Harper Alley and Harper Audio was directed by Cynthia Lee and recorded at Skyline Studios in Oakland, California. This program was produced by John Marshall Media, engineered by Lupe Jimenez, executive producer Almeida Vainy, text copyright 2023 by Kimberly and James Dean, production copyright 2023 by Harper Collins Publishers, all rights reserved. Thank you for listening. Thank you.
